verdict.rationale: Ghostty is a terminal emulator. It does ship a built-in AppleScript dictionary and Apple Shortcuts (AppIntents) support for scripting windows, tabs and input, but these are scripting building blocks. Any autonomous or background scheduling would come from the host OS, not from Ghostty's own automation feature. The runtime probe also found no remote-control or IPC interface in the CLI, so the evidence shows no product-native way to set up recurring or background automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
